logros: Data integration platform in FastAPI + Celery with change data capture: connectors to 6+ ERPs and internal systems unified into one model and consumed by the internal apps.
Warehouse management system as main author, back end (Django / DRF) and front end (Angular 19): multi-tenant, with the inventory audit cycle from scanner count to ERP adjustment.

Designed and built a CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing system (Mexican tax compliance): swappable PAC drivers, payment complements, automatic accounting through an outbox; test suite grown from 1,500 to 3,000 tests in three weeks.
Corporate single sign-on with Keycloak (OIDC) and Vue 3: scoped roles and self-service activation with a second factor.
Three production cutovers (SSO, data platform, WMS) in four days, with rehearsal, rollback plan and backups, and no data loss.
Run 10+ services on GCP with Docker Compose and nginx, separate QA and production environments and automated deploys; GitLab CI/CD and automated tests with pytest.
Modernized two legacy PHP 5.6 applications to PHP 8.3+ without stopping operations.
Manual functional testing, bug reporting in Jira, traffic inspection with Fiddler and Charles, work in Scrum teams.
Project engineer, innovation, molding and quality system coordinator roles; led the ISO 9001:2015 certification and the ABS foundry approval.
Built a quoting system (React, Flask, MySQL) that cut quotation time from days to minutes, and KPI dashboards (Python, SQL) for the plant.
Led grant-funded innovation projects: a robotic marine-propeller manufacturing cell, a sand-mold cell and hydraulic machines; commissioned an 8-meter CNC lathe.
Supervised the molding team and introduced a new molding method that raised quality and production capacity.

dev.texto: At Pyansa I direct external developers: I write the requirements and acceptance criteria, then verify each delivery before it ships. I also take part in technical interviews.

plant.texto: Before software I supervised a molding team and ran a quality management system, reporting to executive leadership.

method.texto: Every change is specified with OpenSpec: proposal, design with the alternatives I discarded, tasks. I also built an MCP server that connects Claude Code to OpenProject, and my own agent skills.

proyectos.media: Local-first manager for a video and anime library: connects to MyAnimeList, syncs and merges series metadata, tracks what you are watching, with a web UI and a desktop tray app.
proyectos.audio: Desktop app (Tauri/Rust + Svelte) that finds duplicate and acoustically similar audio using the Panako fingerprinting engine.
proyectos.dock: Local project launcher with a web UI: start, stop and restart dev servers, with live logs and port detection.

Diseñé y construí un sistema de facturación electrónica CFDI 4.0 (cumplimiento fiscal en México): drivers de PAC intercambiables, complemento de pagos y contabilización automática mediante outbox; suite de pruebas de 1,500 a 3,000 tests en tres semanas.
Inicio de sesión único corporativo con Keycloak (OIDC) y Vue 3: roles por alcance y activación por autoservicio con segundo factor.
Tres cortes de producción (SSO, plataforma de datos y WMS) en cuatro días, con ensayo, plan de reversa y respaldos, sin pérdida de datos.
Opero más de 10 servicios en GCP con Docker Compose y nginx, ambientes de QA y producción separados y despliegues automáticos; CI/CD en GitLab y pruebas automatizadas con pytest.
Modernicé dos aplicaciones heredadas de PHP 5.6 a PHP 8.3+ sin detener la operación.
Pruebas funcionales manuales, reporte de defectos en Jira, inspección de tráfico con Fiddler y Charles, trabajo en equipos Scrum.
Roles de ingeniero de proyecto, coordinador de innovación, de moldeo y del sistema de calidad; lideré la certificación ISO 9001:2015 y la aprobación de fundición de ABS.
Construí un sistema de cotización (React, Flask, MySQL) que redujo el tiempo de cotización de días a minutos, y tableros de KPI (Python, SQL) para la planta.

Dirigí proyectos de innovación con fondos concursables: una celda robótica de manufactura de propelas marinas, una celda de moldes de arena y máquinas hidráulicas; puse en marcha un torno CNC de 8 metros.
Supervisé al equipo de moldeo e introduje un nuevo método de moldeo que elevó la calidad y la capacidad de producción.
